title: Text2Sim: Agentic Physics-Based Simulation Generation with Distilled Expertise
abstract: arXiv:2609.36593v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Creating diverse physical simulations remains labor-intensive because assets, layout, physical parameters, motion, control, and rendering must be designed and debugged jointly. We present Text2Sim, a simulation-specialized agentic pipeline that converts a text-only request into an executable, editable dynamic case. Built on Genesis, Text2Sim uses a hierarchical agentic structure that combines a Planner with specialized Writers, asset-generation tools, and an independent Critic. Compact skills (Debug Cards) distilled from graphics demonstrations provide role-specific physical guidance for execution-based repair. We evaluate physical quality, visual quality, and human preference on 42 held-out prompts spanning rigid, articulated, deformable, and cloth phenomena, with a paper-level split between experience construction and evaluation. translated_title: Text2Sim：基于蒸馏专家知识的智能体物理仿真生成
translated_abstract: 创建多样化的物理仿真仍然十分耗费人力，因为资产、布局、物理参数、运动、控制和渲染必须被联合设计和调试。我们提出了Text2Sim，这是一个面向仿真任务的智能体流水线，能够将纯文本请求转换为可执行、可编辑的动态仿真案例。Text2Sim构建于Genesis之上，采用分层智能体结构，结合了规划器、专业编写器、资产生成工具和独立的评审器。从图形学专家演示中蒸馏出的紧凑技能（调试卡片Debug Cards）为基于执行的修复提供了针对特定角色的物理指导。我们在涵盖刚体、铰接体、可变形体和布料现象的42个保留提示词上评估了物理质量、视觉质量和人类偏好，并采用论文级别的经验构建与评估分离的设计。我们设计了自动化的物理和视觉评分器来评估结果质量，Text2Sim实现了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Text2Sim提出了一种基于Genesis的分层智能体流水线，通过规划器、专业编写器、评审器以及从专家演示中蒸馏出的调试卡片，将纯文本请求自动转换为可执行、可编辑的物理仿真场景。
en_tdlr: Text2Sim is a simulation-specialized hierarchical agentic pipeline built on Genesis that converts text-only requests into executable, editable physics simulations, leveraging distilled Debug Cards for role-specific guidance and execution-based repair.
